canada.summary: Canadian armoured vehicle maker Roshel Inc. will buy the Stellantis assembly plant in Brampton, Ont., the automaker announced Monday.

canada.title: Winnipeg Blue Bombers quarterback Zach Collaros putting off retirement decision for now
canada.summary: Quarterback Zach Collaros got teary when speaking about what could come next at the team's end-of-season availabilities on Sunday.

canada.title: Nahanni Butte criticizes order for environmental assessment before cleanup of abandoned Cantung mine can begin
canada.summary: The Nahɂą Dehé Dene Band in Nahanni Butte, N.W.T., says it's disappointed with the Mackenzie Valley Land and Water Board's decision to send a cleanup plan for the Cantung tungsten mine for an environmental assessment.

canada.title: Sentencing delayed for man who pleaded guilty to killing Oromocto First Nation woman
canada.summary: Sentencing of a man who pleaded guilty to manslaughter in the death of an Oromocto First Nation woman has been postponed after the judge found problems in a Crown and defence recommendation for a 10-year sentence.

canada.title: Winnipeg police issue 2nd warning about tampered Halloween candy
canada.summary: Winnipeg police are again warning parents to check their kids' Halloween candy after getting more reports about chocolate bars containing "various sharp foreign objects."

canada.title: Chiefs question motive behind Indian Act talks after meeting with Carney, premiers
canada.summary: First Nations chiefs say their meeting with the prime minister and premiers was overshadowed by talk of abolishing the Indian Act.

canada.title: Ormstown, Que., mayor calls for more police after 4 suspicious fires targeting restaurants
canada.summary: The mayor of the small Montérégie-region town is calling for more police support after several local restaurants have been targeted over the past few months. The most recent suspected arson left a local pizzeria reduced to rubble over the weekend.

canada.title: After deaths of 2 brothers, Quebec coroner calls for improvements to REM station fence
canada.summary: A Quebec coroner says the REM light-rail network might have to re-evaluate the penetration-resistant fence around Du Quartier station in Brossard, after two young men were fatally hit by a train there about a year ago.

canada.title: Many workers in Nova Scotia, New Brunswick earning below living wage
canada.summary: Two separate reports on the living wages in New Brunswick and Nova Scotia reveal big gaps between what people need to earn just to get by and what they're actually taking home.

canada.title: ‘These kids are so naive’: Doug Ford calls out students protesting OSAP changes
canada.summary: Ontario Premier Doug Ford had some choice words for students who choose to protest recent changes to the Ontario Student Assistance Program. (OSAP)

canada.title: Saskatchewan government proposes restrictions for MAID eligibility
canada.summary: Saskatchewan's government is working to enshrine regulations on MAID eligibility by defining what exactly disqualifies a patient seeking medical assistance in dying.

canada.title: FBI tip about child sexual exploitation leads to charges in Nova Scotia
canada.summary: RCMP say a Tennessee-based investigation identified a Halifax-area man who is believed to have posted child sexual abuse and exploitation material online.

canada.title: Man facing firearms-related charges after MUN incident led to ‘high-risk arrest’ at Logy Bay home: RNC
canada.summary: A 26-year-old man from Logy Bay-Middle Cove-Outer Cove has been charged with several firearms offences following an altercation than began at Memorial University, the Royal Newfoundland Constabulary says.

canada.title: Calgary living wage up slightly from last year: report
canada.summary: The Alberta Living Wage Network says Calgary's living wage — or the amount a full-time worker needs to meet their basic needs, manage unexpected expenses and participate meaningfully in their community — is now $26.90, up from $26.50 last year.

canada.title: Third storm heads for already drenched B.C. coast
canada.summary: The third in a series of storms is heading for B.C., after wild weather knocked out power to thousands, triggered evacuations and left one person dead over the weekend.

canada.title: Report on 'critical challenges' in Lloydminster health care released by Alberta, Saskatchewan
canada.summary: An in-depth analysis that underscored “critical challenges” in Lloydminster’s health-care system has been released in full by the governments of Alberta and Saskatchewan, five months after the contents were deemed confidential.
